Questions management usually asks

Clear answers. No unnecessary complexity.

PropCola is designed to add customer experience intelligence without asking your team to replace the systems already in place.

Does PropCola replace our CRM?+
No. Your existing CRM remains the system of record for customer and sales operations. PropCola works alongside it as a Customer Experience Intelligence layer.
What is PropCola actually used for?+
PropCola helps businesses capture structured customer feedback, understand experience and reputation signals, identify recurring patterns and give management a clearer view of what customers are experiencing.
Who is PropCola designed for?+
PropCola is designed for business owners, business heads, Sales Heads, CRM or CX Heads, Operations Heads, Marketing teams and management teams in customer-facing businesses.
How is PropCola different from a normal feedback form?+
A normal form mainly collects responses. PropCola structures questions around the business objective and turns responses into themes, patterns, trends and management intelligence.
What kind of customer feedback can PropCola capture?+
Depending on the campaign, PropCola can capture experience, professionalism, requirement understanding, information clarity, what customers value, concerns, preferences, competition, alternatives and decision signals.
Does PropCola need customer personal information?+
PropCola can be designed to capture feedback without requiring unnecessary personal information. The questions and data collected should be limited to what is needed for the business objective.
Can PropCola work without changing our existing CRM or ERP?+
Yes. PropCola is designed to sit alongside existing business systems rather than replace them. The goal is to add customer experience intelligence without forcing a CRM or ERP replacement.
What is Reputation Intelligence?+
Reputation Intelligence focuses on public customer feedback such as reviews, recurring themes, response activity and reputation trends, helping management understand how the business is being experienced publicly.
Can PropCola help businesses manage Google Reviews?+
PropCola's Reputation Intelligence is designed to support review monitoring, organization, analysis and response workflows where enabled. Google remains the platform that controls its review system and policies.
Can PropCola help businesses get more Google Reviews?+
PropCola can support compliant review-request workflows using a business's genuine Google review link or QR code. Review requests should reflect real customer experiences and should not use incentives, selective positive-review solicitation or rating manipulation.
Does PropCola remove negative Google Reviews?+
No. PropCola does not control Google's review-removal process. Businesses can identify potentially policy-violating reviews and use Google's reporting process, while genuine negative feedback should be understood and addressed responsibly.
Can PropCola guarantee better Google ratings or rankings?+
No. PropCola does not guarantee ratings, rankings or any specific reputation outcome. Its role is to help businesses understand customer feedback, respond appropriately and improve visibility into customer experience.
What does management actually receive from PropCola?+
Management receives structured customer experience insights, recurring themes, trends, comparison views and decision signals that can help identify strengths, concerns and areas requiring attention.
